name: Bjorn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjorn Halvorsen's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the fjords of Norway. His engineering background quickly led him to a career in vehicle dynamics and race strategy. Before joining ART Grand Prix Academy, he spent several years at various junior formula teams, honing his skills in race operations and driver development. His approach to his role as a sporting director is meticulous and data-driven, always looking for marginal gains. What sets Bjorn apart is his ability to inspire a sense of calm and precision within the team, even amidst the chaos of a race weekend.

Halvorsen is deeply committed to nurturing young talent and believes in fostering a supportive environment where drivers can learn from their mistakes. He emphasizes the importance of teamwork and communication, ensuring that every member of the team understands their role and contributes to the overall success. His experience with ART Grand Prix Academy has been marked by successes in junior formula series, as well as developing future stars for the higher levels of motorsport.
